brief: Draft the scene in French: the evening of 4 November, Bastien closes the shutters and leaves, and Lucienne stays at the bench with the stopped watch under the lamp. One short exchange between them, in guillemets as the style sheet sets them. She does not open the watch and does not learn who M. F. is. Close third person, passé simple, under 250 words. Keep every established fact. Invent nothing.
name: drafting-fr
